candidate.changes: one new workflow; no existing workflow or production-source changes

checks.detail: The existing release macro constructs the explicitly named manual platform_data target from the existing hepta Cargo binary. Ordinary //... target completion alone does not qualify this explicit product.

Direct existing Python wrapper receives ci-linux then ci, explicit opt/musl platform, lockfile_mode=error and remote_download_toplevel. The wrapper inserts keyed remote settings before caller options; keyless fallback removes ci-linux while ci and explicit musl remain. GNU host/exec platforms remain appropriate for host tools; no claim of actual RBE execution before logs.

Pinned Bazel 9.3.0 cquery formatter returns target provider map; DefaultInfo exposes files_to_run; existing platform_data returns an executable symlink and forwards original output files. Selecting files_to_run.executable avoids ambiguous DefaultInfo.files ordering.

The explicit @llvm musl platform is independently cqueried to its real canonical label. Both outer and inner build_options platforms must equal the single observed canonical label. This replaces a guessed repository-name regex.
Both target queries have exact one-row cardinality; the inner hepta query is scoped to the platform wrapper universe. Main-workspace label acceptance is exact //... or @@//..., not suffix-only.

Provider paths must be relative bazel-out paths without parent traversal. Reported execution root must be under output_base; inner resolved executable remains within execution root; outer and inner must be the same file. The copied artifact is executable and byte-hash equal to the selected inner output.

Actual bytes must be ELF64 little-endian x86_64 ET_EXEC or ET_DYN with no PT_INTERP or DT_NEEDED. Exactly one --version and one --help process are executed from the staged hash-bound bytes, each bounded to 30 seconds, with pre/post and terminal artifact hashes. Source defines Hepta CLI and hepta version/help strings before normal product command dispatch.

Checkout is exact GITHUB_SHA; raw git commit headers preserve true parent IDs under shallow checkout. Initial and terminal HEAD/tree/tracked cleanliness are checked, plus tool/config/source input blobs and native Linux x86_64 runner receipt.

Workflow-provided BuildBuddy key is removed from smoke environment and replaced in text artifacts before upload. Raw BEP stays outside upload directory; only allowlisted event/metric projection and raw-BEP digest are retained. Expanded remote-header command lines are not put in the receipt.

Build/query/process nonzero and timeouts remain failures; final qualification requires prior success and unchanged source/product. Failure artifacts can upload after successful sanitization. No retries, ignored tests, release, original CI changes, or original budget extensions are introduced.

remaining_gates: Parse the actual final YAML and all inline Python before publication.
Run the added workflow at the exact published source/merge SHA; retain real build/cquery/ELF/process receipts and original logs.
Do not promote this narrow build/process smoke to the existing musl integration matrix or deployment qualification.
